title: Global shortcut for 'Minimize All' doesn't work well with the respective applet
line: The Minimize All Windows widget and the Meta+Shift+D shortcut can now undo each other.
explanation: The Minimize All Windows widget and KWin's optional Minimize All script (Meta+Shift+D) each kept a private list of the windows they had minimized. After the shortcut, the widget found nothing to minimize, marked itself active with an empty list and restored nothing; after the widget, the shortcut found none of its own windows and only brought back the window it re-activated. The script's logic now lives in KWin itself (a small MinimizeAll class), which the script calls through new workspace.toggleMinimizeAll()/toggleMinimizeAllOthers() scripting methods and which is exposed on org.kde.KWin as toggleMinimizeAll() plus a minimizingAll property with a change signal. The widget drops its own logic and uses that D-Bus API, so there is one implementation and one list of minimized windows, and its active state follows KWin's.

commits.message:
plugins/minimizeall: move the logic into KWin and add a D-Bus API

The Minimize All script kept the windows it minimized in script state,
so the Minimize All Windows widget could not undo them. The logic now
lives in KWin, used by the script and exposed on org.kde.KWin.

BUG: 420460

applets/showdesktop: use KWin's Minimize All in the Minimize All widget

The widget only remembered the windows it had minimized itself, so it
and KWin's Minimize All shortcut could not undo each other. It now uses
KWin's Minimize All toggle and state over D-Bus instead.
